headline: Vassar leads the conference at both ends
dek: Across all matches, Vassar scored 44 goals and conceded only six, dropping just one match alongside eleven wins and five draws. William Smith claimed the conference table without a league defeat, yet Vassar's balance in front of both goals separated it from the rest of the field.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Attacking output splits sharply between the frontrunners and a compressed middle pack, with Vassar's 44 goals outscoring Union (N.Y.) and Bard combined.

wire.line: William Smith finished with sixteen wins, five losses, and zero draws across all matches.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Vassar spread its scoring across at least fifteen different players during the season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Skidmore forward Abby Lewis led the conference in goals, scoring eleven times on 40 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: William Smith goalkeeper Antonia Goerke stopped 71 shots while conceding fourteen goals, posting an .835 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Union (N.Y.) drew eight matches alongside seven wins and four losses, finishing with more draws than victories or defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bard conceded 42 goals while scoring seventeen across all matches.

last_match.line: William Smith closed the season without a draw after going unbeaten in conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
